transcript.line: Every little step has helped you grow into who you are today. And there are so many wonderful adventures still ahead.

transcript.speaker: Dora
transcript.line: Today is for your favorite things, sweet surprises, and people who love you.

transcript.speaker: Dora
transcript.line: Ready, Akhila? Let’s go on an adventure!

voiceLines: Hi Akhi! Happy birthday! Keep your first envelope close, and tap for a hint whenever you need one.

stops.title: A small beginning
stops.clue: Your first surprise is tucked away, where I rest my head at the end of the day.
hints: You don’t need to leave this room for this one.
Think soft. Think where heads go at night.
Look under the pillow.
stops.codePrompt: The gift tag has a word on it.
stops.sfxPrompt: Soft pillow whoosh followed by a gentle magical sparkle, cozy and short
voiceLines: Envelope one! Your first surprise is tucked away, where I rest my head at the end of the day.

stops.title: Follow the water
stops.clue: Winter in the name, royalty in the tea. Your usual order, remembered by me.
hints: This one is something to drink.
Your favorite boba place — the one with a number in its name.
T4: Wintermelon Milk Tea with royal tea instead of Earl Grey.
stops.sfxPrompt: Playful boba straw slurp with ice cubes rattling in a plastic cup
voiceLines: Envelope two! Winter in the name, royalty in the tea. Your usual order, remembered by me.

stops.title: Class break
stops.clue: Even an Avatar has classes. Your adventure continues afterward.
stops.resumeNote: The hunt picks back up around 2. No rush.
stops.sfxPrompt: Soft, sleepy little leopard snore, cute and quiet
voiceLines: Go be responsible, I’ll nap till 2.

stops.title: An envelope from your people
stops.clue: Even an Avatar needs to eat. On Monroe, build your favorite bowl—one ingredient at a time.
hints: Your friends know you’re hungry after class.
A place on Monroe where you build your bowl down the line.
Qdoba on Monroe.

pizza.clue: Even an Avatar needs to eat. Your friends picked a slice of something you love — follow them to {place}.
hints: Your friends know you’re hungry after class.
Round, cheesy, cut into triangles.
Pizza at {place}.

stops.sfxPrompt: Sizzling skillet on a hot grill, short and appetizing
voiceLines: Envelope three — from your people! Even an Avatar needs to eat. On Monroe, build your favorite bowl, one ingredient at a time.

stops.title: A place with roots
stops.clue: We’ve both called this place home. One of your favorites still stands here, putting down roots.
hints: Somewhere you both used to live.
The Retreat — and something tall and green you love there.
Your favorite tree at the Retreat.
stops.codePrompt: Someone new is waiting by the tree. Check their tag.
stops.photoPrompt: You, your tree, and your new spotted friend.
stops.sfxPrompt: Leaves rustling in a light breeze with soft birdsong
voiceLines: Envelope four! We’ve both called this place home. One of your favorites still stands here, putting down roots.

stops.title: A little spark
stops.clue: Before holding hands became our thing, our fingertips had their first little meeting. Find the spot outside the café with an explosive name.
hints: A memory from a slightly blurry night out.
A café on Monroe whose name sounds like something dropping from the sky.
Outside Bombs Away Cafe.
stops.codePrompt: There’s a word hidden in your note.
stops.foundLabel: A note and a little Avatar trinket
stops.sfxPrompt: Soft cute cartoon poof with a tiny sparkle
voiceLines: Envelope five! Before holding hands became our thing, our fingertips had their first little meeting. Find the spot outside the café with an explosive name.

stops.title: A little air time
stops.clue: At four, find the court where love means zero and the shuttle does the flying.
hints: Bring your energy — this one’s a game.
Rackets, nets, and a shuttle. On campus.
The badminton courts at Dixon.

homeBackup.title: A little playtime
homeBackup.clue: Your next clue is waiting where today began. Come home at four—there’s more to unwrap.
hints: Head back to where the day started.
You’ve been here once already today.
Back home — your people are waiting.

stops.sfxPrompt: Badminton shuttlecock thwack followed by a small happy crowd cheer
voiceLines: Envelope six! At four, find the court where love means zero and the shuttle does the flying.
